name: Muncul
summary: Financial consulting site on warm off-white with black panels and a chartreuse accent, a dark full-bleed city hero, rounded inset card grids and a black pricing slab with tabbed plans.

fonts.pairing: Inter Display 500 headlines with -0.02em tracking over Inter body; small uppercase labels above every heading

signature: dark-tinted full-bleed skyline hero with a white pill nav centred and vertical slide dots on the right
chartreuse pill buttons with a dark green circular arrow cap
process steps as four tall cream cards inside a pale inset tray, followed by a wide photo tile and a black CTA tile
black rounded pricing slab with a segmented plan toggle, a plan card and a wide inclusions card
headings rise word by word on scroll
imagery: muted city and office photography, people at desks and in meetings, video stills; darkened for hero contrast
layout_grid: 1140px content inside 30px side padding, 100px section padding, 3-column service grid, 4-column step and stat rows, 20px card radius, 100px pill radius
